data.content_ref: inline:After the grounded fixpoint labels every node, materialize a DefenseWitness artifact for each accepted node x: one greedy polynomial set of accepted defenders that together attack all attackers of x. This is a deterministic post-pass over final labels and attack graph; because each witness is computed by a bounded greedy scan and there are at most n witnesses, total cost remains polynomial. The witness is a derived record, not an input to the fixpoint, so determinism and reinstatement-as-derived are untouched. The causal mechanism is explicit: acceptance is explained by a concrete, replayable defense set, making it possible to audit why a conjecture was accepted without changing the skeptical semantics.
